race.comment: STAFFO (7) finished out of the money two starts back then she was always well out of her ground and was beaten 5.5 lengths when fifth over 1200m at Dalby three weeks ago. Facing a tougher assignment but she is good enough to take this out. NORTHFIRE (4) turned in a fair effort at Tamworth over 1600m at his last run five months ago, finishing fourth and beaten 1.3 lengths. Expect him to play a major role. ERNIEGY (2) is back after a break of five-and-a-half months. Went close to a maiden win before the layoff, finishing third at his latest appearance over 1400m at Tamworth. Good effort to open last prep when in the money at Gunnedah over 1300m. Placed in a recent trial. Rates highly and is a chance to break through. STRYKE AN ICON (8) finished third last time over 1200m at Tamworth when resuming from a spell, beaten 2.75 lengths. Will trim down second-up. Nicely placed to fill a top-three spot again.
